summary: The filing is a routine Form 8-K Item 8.01 update from ExchangeRight Income Fund, providing status of its ongoing private placement offering, share issuance figures as of April 30, 2026, and details of regular monthly dividend declarations and dividend reinvestment plan elections. No special-situation corporate event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change is described. The filing is purely informational and not triggered by a transformative event.
